questions.question: Dr. Berrada has submitted his application for contracting. Dr. Cherkaoui asks him to check the conditions. According to Article 6 of Decree 2.12.507, what is an eligibility condition?
options: Have practiced 5 years in the private sector
Not have been subject to an ordinal disciplinary sanction
Have a practice in a rural area
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Article 6 stipulates that candidates must not have been subject to an ordinal disciplinary sanction.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will check my disciplinary record.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada has been selected. Dr. Cherkaoui explains the duration of the agreement. According to Article 5, what is the maximum duration of an agreement?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The agreement is concluded for 11 months maximum, renewable tacitly three times at most.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will note the deadlines.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui informs Dr. Berrada that he will be subject to hierarchical authority. According to Article 9, to whom is the contracted dentist subject?
options: To the president of the ONMD
To the hierarchical head of the public health establishment
Directly to the Minister of Health
To the mayor of the commune
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Article 9 provides that the contracted dentist is subject to the authority of the hierarchical head of the health establishment.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will meet the head of department.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about professional obligations. According to Article 9, contracted dentists are subject to the same obligations as:
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Contracted dentists are subject to the same professional obligations as their civil servant counterparts.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will read the internal regulations.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada had to be absent for an emergency. Dr. Cherkaoui reminds him of the rules. According to Article 10, what risk does a contracted dentist face for an unjustified absence?
options: Termination of the agreement without notice
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Article 10 provides for termination without notice in case of absence during three sessions without valid reason.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will notify the administration in case of absence.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the termination process. According to Article 5, what are the modalities of termination of the agreement?
options: Termination by decision of the administration or at the dentist's request with one month's notice
Automatic termination at the end of the contract
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Unless terminated by decision of the administration or at the dentist's request, it is obligatory to notify the other party at least one month before the termination date.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will respect the notice period.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about the selection procedure. According to Article 3, which criterion is prioritized in the case of multiple applications?
options: The professional address closest to the health establishment
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'In the event of multiple applications, the doctor whose professional address is closest to the health establishment concerned will be retained.' Dr. Berrada: 'I am well located geographically.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the role of professional orders. According to Article 3, what must the agreements be endorsed with?
options: The visa of the president of the national council of the relevant professional order
The signature of the head of the establishment
The approval of the communal council
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The agreements must be endorsed with the visa of the president of the national council of the relevant professional order.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will ensure this formality.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wants to know his remuneration. According to Article 11, what is the amount for a 4-hour session?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Article 11 sets the remuneration for a four-hour work session at 286 DH gross.' Dr. Berrada: 'It's a fixed amount.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui informs Dr. Berrada about allowances. According to Article 11, can contracted dentists benefit from travel allowances?
options: No, travel expenses are not covered
Yes, under the conditions and rates set by the regulations
Only if they practice in rural areas
No, they must pay their own expenses
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Contracted dentists can benefit from travel expense allowances at the rates set by the regulatory texts.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will check the rates.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about responsibility. According to Article 9, what is the responsibility of the contracted dentist towards interns?
options: They direct and supervise the work of interns placed under their authority
They are responsible only for surgical acts
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Contracted dentists direct and supervise the work of interns and staff placed directly under their authority.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will supervise the interns.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the accumulation of agreements. According to Article 3, can a contracted dentist hold several agreements?
options: Yes, but only within the territorial jurisdiction of the same regional health directorate
No, they can only have one agreement
Yes, if the regions are distant
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The activities of the contracted dentist must be exercised within the territorial jurisdiction of the same regional health directorate.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will limit myself to one region.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada is interested in disciplinary procedures. According to Article 10, what are the causes of termination for professional misconduct?
options: A serious professional misconduct after consultation with the national council of the order
A disagreement with the head of department
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'In case of serious professional misconduct, termination is taken after consultation with the national council of the professional order.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will be irreproachable.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the geographical limits. According to Article 3, the districts concerned by contracting are defined by:
options: An order of the Minister of Health
The head of the health establishment
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The districts concerned are defined by order of the Minister of Health.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will consult the order.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about compliance with internal regulations. According to Article 9, is the contracted dentist subject to the internal regulations of the establishment?
options: No, they are subject to their own rules
Yes, they are subject to the internal regulations of the health facility
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Contracted dentists are subject to compliance with the internal regulations of the assignment establishments.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will read the regulations.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the repeal of the old decree. According to Article 15, what becomes of the 1972 decree?
options: It is still valid for certain regions
It was replaced by a law
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Article 15 repeals Decree No. 2-71-641 of January 24, 1972.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will refer to the new decree.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about on-call duty. According to Article 9, can contracted dentists be assigned on-call duty?
options: No, on-call duty is reserved for civil servants
Yes, according to the regulatory procedures applicable to civil servants
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'On-call duty must be performed according to the regulatory procedures applicable to civil servant counterparts.' Dr. Berrada: 'I am available for on-call duty.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui informs Dr. Berrada about the call for applications. According to Article 3, how is the recruitment of contracted dentists carried out?
options: By call for applications launched by the Ministry of Health
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The use of private dentists takes place following a call for applications launched by the Ministry of Health.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will follow the calls for applications.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada is interested in the remuneration cap. According to Article 11, what is the maximum monthly amount received by a contracted dentist?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The maximum monthly gross remuneration is 7,143 DH.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will calculate my working time.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the duration of renewal. According to Article 5, how many times can the agreement be renewed tacitly?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The agreement is renewable tacitly three times at most.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will note the renewal deadlines.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about supporting documents. According to Article 6, what documents are necessary for the application for contracting?
options: Proof of registration with the Order and certificate of non-disciplinary sanction
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Candidates must provide proof of registration with the Order and a certificate of non-disciplinary sanction.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will prepare my file.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the administrative follow-up. According to Article 9, what documents must the contracted dentist sign?
options: All technical and administrative documents related to their activity
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Contracted dentists must sign all technical and administrative documents related to their activity.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will check each document before signing.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada wonders about the location. According to Article 3, the activities of the contracted dentist must be exercised:
options: Within the territorial jurisdiction of the same regional health directorate
In the region of their private practice
In the city of their choice
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The activities of the contracted dentist must be exercised within the territorial jurisdiction of the same regional health directorate.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will choose my region.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui explains the reasons for refusal. According to Article 6, what convictions prevent contracting?
options: Conviction for crimes against persons or offenses against public morality
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Convictions for crimes against persons or offenses against public morality prevent contracting.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will provide my criminal record.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada, after having mastered contracting procedures with Dr. Cherkaoui, receives his congratulations. What is the next step for Dr. Berrada?
options: Become an expert in contracting and public health
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Mastery of contracting is a valuable skill. Becoming an expert is the next step.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will train in public health.'
